Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > General > Common Procedures > MONP message transport
Content: In order to participate in a call of an MCPTT group, the MCPTT client: shall send the MONP message as a UDP message to the multicast IP address of the MCPTT group, to UDP port 8809, with an IP time-to-live set to 255; and shall treat UDP messages received on the multicast IP address of the MCPTT group and on port 8809 as received MONP messages. The MONP message is the entire payload of the UDP message.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > General > Common Procedures > Session description
Content: For an off-network MCPTT session, only MCPTT speech is used. One off-network MCPTT session includes one media-floor control entity. The MCPTT client shall generate an SDP body for a group call in accordance with rules and procedures of RFC4566 . The MCPTT client: shall include in the session-level section: [ a) ] the "o=" field with the username portion set to a dash; the "s=" field with the session name portion set to a dash; and the "c=" field with the nettype portion set to "IN", the addrtype portion set to the IP version of a multicast IP address of the MCPTT group and the connection-address portions set to the multicast IP address of the MCPTT group; shall include the media-level section for MCPTT speech consisting of: [ a) ] the "m=" field with the media portion set to "audio", the port portion set to a port number for MCPTT speech of the MCPTT group, the proto field set to "RTP/AVP" and fmt portion set indicating RTP payload type numbers; the "i=" field with the session description portion set to "speech"; the "a=fmtp:" attribute(s), the "a=rtpmap:" attribute(s) or both, indicating the codec(s) and media parameters of the MCPTT speech with the following clarification: [ i) ] if the "/ x / x /Common/PreferredVoiceCodec" leaf node is present in the group document configured on the group management client as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 containing an RTP payload format name as specified in IETF RFC 4566 , indicating a preferred voice codec for an MCPTT group; and if the MCPTT client supports the encoding name indicated in the value of the "name" attribute; then the MCPTT client: shall insert the value of the "/ x / x /Common/PreferredVoiceCodec" leaf node in the encoding name field of the "a=rtpmap" attribute as defined in IETF RFC 4566 ; and the "a=rtcp:" attribute indicating port number to be used for RTCP at the MCPTT client selected according to the rules and procedures of IETF RFC 3605 , if the media steam uses other than the default IP address; and shall include the media-level section for media-floor control entity consisting of: [ a) ] an "m=" line, with the media portion set to "application", the port portion set to a port number for media-floor control entity of the MCPTT group, the proto field set to "udp" and fmt portion set to "MCPTT"; and the "a=fmtp:MCPTT" attribute indicating the parameters of the media-floor control entity as specified 3GPP TS 24.380 .
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > General
Content: In this release of specification, media streams of off-network group call cannot be modified and the SDP is the same for the entire duration of the call. The maximum number of simultaneous off-network group calls is limited by the value of "/ x /Common/MCPTTGroupCall/MaxCallN4" leaf node present in the UE configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 .
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Basic call control state machine
Content: The Figure 10.2.2.2-1 gives an overview of the main states and transitions on the UE for call control. Each call control state machine is per MCPTT group ID. The following pieces of information are associated with the basic call control state machine: [ a) ] the stored call identifier of the call; the probe response value of the call; the stored refresh interval of the call; the stored SDP body of the call; the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call; the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; and the stored call start time of the call. The basic call control state machine has a related call type control state machine described in clause 10.2.3.2. When sending the message, MCPTT client indicates the stored current ProSe per-packet priority associated with the call type control state machine to the lower layers.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S1: start-stop
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE is not part of an ongoing call. This state is the start state of this state machine. This state is the stop state of this state machine.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S2: waiting for call announcement
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE has sent a GROUP CALL PROBE message and is waiting for a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S3: part of ongoing call
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE is part of an ongoing group call.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S4: pending user action without confirm indication
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE has presented a notification to the MCPTT user for the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, is waiting for a response and is not expected to send confirm indication.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S5: pending user action with confirm indication
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE has presented a notification to the MCPTT user for the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, is waiting for a response and is expected to send confirm indication.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S6: ignoring incoming call announcements
Content: This state exists for UE, when the group call was rejected or released, GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message was sent or received and GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT messages continue being received.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Call Control states > S7: waiting for call announcement after call release
Content: This state exists for UE, when the group call was released, GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message was neither sent nor received and GROUP CALL PROBE was sent.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > General > Call announcement timer calculation > Periodic call announcement timer calculation
Content: The MCPTT client: shall generate a random number, X, with uniform distribution between 0 and 1; and shall set the TFG2 (periodic announcement) timer as follows: TFG2 (periodic announcement) = the refresh interval of the call * (2/3 + 2/3*X) seconds.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > General > Call announcement timer calculation > Call announcement timer calculation after CALL PROBE
Content: The MCPTT client: shall generate a random number, X, with uniform distribution between 0 and 1; and shall set the TFG2 (periodic announcement) timer as follows: TFG2 (periodic announcement) = 1/12*X seconds.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > General > Max duration timer calculation
Content: The MCPTT client shall set the TFG6 (max duration) timer as follows: TFG6 (max duration) = X (Y Z) seconds, where: X = value of "/ x / x /OffNetwork/MaxDuration" leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; Y = current UTC time, in seconds since midnight UTC of January 1, 1970 (not counting leap seconds); Z = Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message or the stored call start time, if a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message was not received that caused this max duration timer calculation to be invoked.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call Probe > Call probe initiation
Content: When in the "S1: start-stop" state, upon an indication from an MCPTT user to initiate a group call for an MCPTT group ID, the MCPTT client: shall store the MCPTT group ID as the MCPTT group ID of the call; shall create a call type control state machine as described in clause 10.2.3.2; shall generate a GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 15.1.2. In the GROUP CALL PROBE message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall send the GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall start timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission); shall start timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement); and shall enter the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call Probe > Call probe retransmission
Content: When in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, upon expiration of TFG3 (call probe retransmission), the MCPTT client: shall generate a GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 15.1.2. In the GROUP CALL PROBE message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall send the GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall start timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission); and shall remain in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call Probe > Receiving GROUP CALL PROBE message when participating in the ongoing call
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL PROBE message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: if the stored probe response value of the call is set to "false": [ a) ] shall stop timer TFG2 (call announcement); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.2; and shall set the stored probe response of the call to "true"; and shall remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > Not receiving any response to GROUP CALL PROBE message
Content: When in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, upon expiry of timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement), the MCPTT client: shall stop timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission), if running; shall generate an SDP body as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.2 and store it as the SDP body of the call; shall generate a random number with uniform distribution between 0 and 65535 and store it as the call identifier of the call; shall select refresh interval value and store it as the refresh interval of the call; shall store own MCPTT user ID as the originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the current UTC time as the call start time of the call; shall generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 15.1.3. In the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the Call identifier IE to the stored call identifier of the call; shall set the Call type IE to the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine; shall set the Refresh interval IE to the stored refresh interval of the call; shall set the SDP IE to the stored SDP body of the call; shall set the Originating MCPTT user ID IE to the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall set the Call start time IE to the stored call start time of the call; shall set the Last call type change time IE to the stored last call type change time of the call associated with call type control state machine; shall set the Last user to change call type IE to last user to change call type associated with call type control state machine; and may include the Confirm mode indication IE; shall send the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as originating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2 (using stored call start time); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state. Note: In this release of the specification, the refresh interval of the call is fixed to 10 seconds.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > Receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message
Content: When in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: shall stop timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission); shall stop timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement); shall store the value of the SDP IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the SDP body of the call; shall store the value of the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call identifier of the call; shall store the value of the originating MCPTT user ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the Originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the value of the Refresh interval IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the refresh interval of the call; shall store the value of the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call start time of the call; shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2; shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > Receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message when not participating in the ongoing call
Content: When in the "S1: start-stop" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE not matching MCPTT group ID of the call stored for other state machines, the MCPTT client: shall store the value of the SDP IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the SDP body of the call; shall store the value of the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call identifier of the call; shall store the value of the Originating MCPTT user ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the value of the Refresh interval IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the refresh interval of the call; shall store the value of the MCPTT group ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the MCPTT group ID of the call; shall store the value of the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call start time of the call; shall create a call type control state machine as described in clause 10.2.3.2; if the terminating UE is configured that the terminating MCPTT user acknowledgement is required upon a terminating call request reception: [ a) ] shall start timer TFG4 (waiting for the user); if the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message contains the Confirm mode indication IE, shall enter the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state; and if the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message does not contains the Confirm mode indication IE, shall enter the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state; and if the terminating UE is configured that the terminating MCPTT user acknowledgement is not required upon a terminating call request reception: [ a) ] shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; if the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message contains the Confirm mode indication IE: [ i) ] shall generate a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message as specified in clause 15.1.4. In the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message, the MCPTT client: [ A) ] shall set the Call identifier IE to the stored call identifier of the call; shall set the Sending MCPTT user ID IE to own MCPTT user id; shall set the Call type IE to the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine; and shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; and shall send the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2; shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > MCPTT user accepts the terminating call with confirm indication
Content: When in the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state, upon indication from the MCPTT user to accept the incoming group call, the MCPTT client: shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall generate a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message as specified in clause 15.1.4. In the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the Call identifier IE to the stored call identifier of the call; shall set the Sending MCPTT user ID IE to own MCPTT user id; shall set the Call type IE to the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine; and shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; and shall send the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall stop timer TFG4; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2 (using stored call start time); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > MCPTT user accepts the terminating call without confirm indication
Content: When in the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to accept the incoming group call, the MCPTT client: shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall stop timer TFG4; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2 (using stored call start time); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > Receiving GROUP CALL ACCEPT message
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: can inform the MCPTT user about the call acceptance; and shall remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > MCPTT user rejects the terminating call
Content: When in the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state or the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to reject the incoming group call, the MCPTT client: shall stop timer TFG4 (waiting for the user); shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); and shall enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call setup > MCPTT user does not act on terminating call
Content: When in the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state or the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state, upon expiration of timer TFG4 (waiting for the user), the MCPTT client: shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); and shall enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Periodic group call announcement > Sending periodic call announcement
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon expiry of timer TFG2 (call announcement), the MCPTT client: shall generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 15.1.3. In the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the Call identifier IE to the stored call identifier of the call; shall set the Call type IE to the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine; shall set the Refresh interval IE to the stored refresh interval of the call; shall set the SDP IE to the stored SDP body of the call; shall set the Originating MCPTT user ID IE to the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall set the Last call type change time IE to the stored last call type change time of the call associated with call type control state machine; shall set the Last user to change call type IE to last user to change call type associated with call type control state machine; shall set the Call start time IE to the stored call start time of the call; if the stored probe response value of the call is set to "true", shall include Probe response IE; shall send the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 10.2.2.1.1.1; if the stored probe response value of the call is set to "true", shall set the stored probe response value of the call to "false"; shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Periodic group call announcement > Receiving periodic call announcement
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the Call start time IE being the same as the stored call start time of the call, the Last call type change time IE being the same as the stored last call type change time of the call associated with the call type control state machine, the Last user to change call type IE being the same as the stored last user to change call type of the call associated with the call type control state machine and the Call identifier IE being the same as the stored call identifier of the call and Call type IE same as the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine and: if the stored probe response value of the call is set to "true" and GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message contains Probe response IE; or if the stored probe response value of the call is set to "false": the MCPTT client, shall stop timer TFG2 (call announcement); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; shall set the stored probe response of the call to "false", if set to "true" ; and shall remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > MCPTT user leaves the call when GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT was sent or received
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, the "S5: pending user action with confirm indication" state, or the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to release the group call, the MCPTT client: shall release the media session, if established; shall stop floor control as specified in clause 7.2.3.9.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall stop timer TFG4 (waiting for the user), if running; shall stop timer TFG2 (call announcement), if running; shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); shall stop timer TFG6 (max duration), if running; and shall enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > Receiving GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message for rejected or released call
Content: When in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: shall store the value of the SDP IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the SDP body of the call; shall store the value of the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call identifier of the call; shall store the value of the Originating MCPTT user ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the value of the Refresh interval IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the refresh interval of the call; shall store the value of the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call start time of the call; shall stop timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); and shall remain in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > MCPTT user initiates originating call for rejected or released call
Content: When in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to initiate a group call for an MCPTT group ID matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: stop timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); shall establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call; shall start floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2 (using stored call start time); shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > No GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT messages for rejected or released call
Content: When in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state, upon expiration of timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements), the MCPTT client: shall release the stored SDP body of the call; shall release the stored call identifier of the call; shall release the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall release the stored refresh interval of the call; shall release the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall release the stored call start time of the call; shall destroy the call type control state machine as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.10 or 10.2.3.4.11; and shall enter the "S1: start-stop" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > MCPTT user leaves the call when GROUP CALL PROBE was sent
Content: When in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to release the group call, the MCPTT client: shall stop timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission); and shall enter the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > MCPTT user initiates originating call for released call
Content: When in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state, upon an indication from the MCPTT user to initiate a group call for an MCPTT group ID matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: shall stop timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement); shall generate a GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 15.1.2. In the GROUP CALL PROBE message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; and shall send the GROUP CALL PROBE message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1; shall start timer TFG3 (call probe retransmission); shall start timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement); and shall enter the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > Receiving GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message for released call
Content: When in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call, the MCPTT client: shall store the value of the SDP IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the SDP body of the call; shall store the value of the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call identifier of the call; shall store the value of the Originating MCPTT user ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the value of the Refresh interval IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the refresh interval of the call; shall store the value of the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call start time of the call; shall stop timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement); shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); and shall enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > No GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT messages for released call
Content: When in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state, upon expiration of timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement), the MCPTT client: shall release the stored MCPTT group ID of the call; shall destroy the call type control state machine as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.11; and shall enter the "S1: start-stop" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Call release > Max duration reached
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon expiration of timer TFG6 (max duration), the MCPTT client: shall release the media session; shall stop floor control as specified in clause 7.2.3.9.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall stop timer TFG2 (call announcement), if running; shall start timer TFG5 (not present incoming call announcements); and shall enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Merge of calls > Merge of two calls
Content: When in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching the stored MCPTT group ID of the call and: the Originating MCPTT user ID IE is different from the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call; or the Call identifier IE is different from the stored call identifier of the call; then: if the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine is "BASIC GROUP CALL" and the value of the Call type IE of GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is either "IMMI N ENT PERIL GROUP CALL" or "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; if the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine is "IMMI N ENT PERIL GROUP CALL" and the value of the Call type IE of GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; if the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine being equal to the Call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message being lower than the stored call start time of the call; or if the stored current call type associated with the call type control state machine being equal to the Call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message being equal to the stored call start time of the call and the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message being lower than the stored call identifier of the call; the MCPTT client: shall store the value of the SDP IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the SDP body of the call; shall store the value of the Call identifier IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call identifier of the call; shall store the value of the Originating MCPTT user ID IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the originating MCPTT user ID of the call; shall store the value of the Refresh interval IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the refresh interval of the call; shall store the value of the Call start time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as the call start time of the call; shall adjust the media session based on the stored SDP body of the call and restart floor control as terminating floor participant as specified in clause 7.2 in 3GPP TS 24.380 ; shall stop timer TFG6 (max duration); shall start timer TFG6 (max duration) with value as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.2; shall stop timer TFG2 (call announcement); and shall start timer TFG2 (call announcement) with value according to rules and procedures as specified in clause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1; and shall remain in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Basic call control > Procedures > Error handling
Content: 10.2.2.4.7.1 Unexpected MONP message received Upon receiving a MONP message in a state where there is no handling specified for the MONP message, the MCPTT client shall discard the MONP message. 10.2.2.4.7.2 Unexpected indication from MCPTT user Upon receiving an indication from the MCPTT user in a state where there is no handling specified for the indication, the MCPTT client shall ignore the indication. 10.2.2.4.7.3 Unexpected expiration of a timer Upon expiration of a timer in a state where there is no handling specified for expiration of the timer, the MCPTT client shall ignore the expiration of the timer.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > General
Content: This state machine exists in parallel with the basic call control state machine for off-network group call as specified in clause 10.2.2.2.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Call type control state machine
Content: The Figure 10.2.3.2-1 gives an overview of the states and transitions of the state machine. The following pieces of information are associated with the call type control state machine: [ a) ] the stored current call type; the stored current ProSe per-packet priority; the stored last call type change time of the call; and the stored last user to change call type of the call. When sending the message, MCPTT client indicates the stored current ProSe per-packet priority (as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ) associated with the call type control state machine to the lower layers.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Call type control states > T0: waiting for call to establish
Content: This state is the start state of this state machine.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Call type control states > T1: in-progress emergency group call
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE is part of an in-progress emergency group call.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Call type control states > T2: in-progress basic group call
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE is part of an in-progress basic group call.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Call type control states > T3: in-progress imminent peril group call
Content: This state exists for UE, when the UE is part of an in-progress imminent peril group call.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > General > Implicit downgrade (emergency) timer calculation
Content: The MCPTT client shall set the TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) timer as follows: TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) = X (Y Z) seconds, where: [ a) ] X = value of "/ x / x /OffNetwork/EmergencyCallCancel" leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; Y = current UTC time, in seconds since midnight UTC of January 1, 1970 (not counting leap seconds); and Z = Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message or the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL EMERGENCY END message.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > General > Implicit downgrade (imminent peril) timer calculation
Content: The MCPTT client shall set the TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) timer as follows: TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) = X (Y Z) seconds, where: [ a) ] X = value of "/ x / x /OffNetwork/ImminentPerilCallCancel" leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; Y = current UTC time, in seconds since midnight UTC of January 1, 1970 (not counting leap seconds); and Z = Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message or the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL IMMINENT PERIL END message.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > User initiated the call probe
Content: When in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish "state, upon an indication from an MCPTT user to initiate a group call probe for an MCPTT group, the MCPTT client: if the stored emergency state associated with emergency alert state machine described in 12.2.2.2 is set to "true" and the value of "/ x / x /Common/AllowedEmergencyCall" leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 is set to "true": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; if the stored emergency state associated with emergency alert state machine described in 12.2.2.2 is set to "false", and: [ a) ] if the user initiates an MCPTT emergency call and the values of " / x / x /Common/MCPTTGroupCall/EmergencyCall/Enabled" leaf node present in the user profile and "/ x / x /Common/AllowedEmergencyCall" leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 are set to "true": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; if the user initiates an MCPTT imminent peril group call and the values of " / x / x /Common/MCPTTGroupCall/ImminentPerilCall/Authorised" leaf node present in the user profile "/ x / x /Common/AllowedImminentPerilCall "leaf node present in group configuration as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 are set to "true": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; and if the user initiates an MCPTT group call which is not an MCPTT emergency call and which is not an MCPTT imminent peril group call: [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network basic group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall set the stored last call type change time to current UTC time; shall set the last user to change call type to own MCPTT user ID; and shall remain in "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as a response to GROUP CALL PROBE message
Content: When in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish " state, upon receipt of a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as a response to GROUP CALL PROBE message, the MCPTT client: if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall set the stored last call type change time to the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored last user to change call type to the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL", and if the stored current call type is other than "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall set the stored last call type change time to the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored last user to change call type to the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; and if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL", and if the stored current call type is "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored last call type change time to the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored last user to change call type to the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; and shall enter "T2: in-progress basic group call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT with MCPTT user acknowledgement required
Content: When in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state, upon receipt of a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message by an idle MCPTT client when MCPTT user acknowledgement is required, the MCPTT client: if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; and shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network basic group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall set the stored last call type change time to the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the last user to change call type to the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; and 6) shall remain in "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT without MCPTT user acknowledgement required
Content: When in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state, upon receipt of a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message by an idle MCPTT client when MCPTT user acknowledgement is not required, the MCPTT client: shall set the stored last call type change time to the Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the last user to change call type to the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; and if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network basic group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; and shall enter "T2: in-progress basic group call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Call started
Content: When in state "T0: waiting for the call to establish", if: [ a) ] the MCPTT user accepts the call when MCPTT user acknowledgement is required; or the MCPTT client sends a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message on expiry of timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement) associated with the basic call control state machine; the MCPTT client: if the stored current call type is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" [ a) ] shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; if the stored current call type is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" [ a) ] shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; or if the stored current call type is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL" [ a) ] shall enter "T2: in-progress basic group call" state.
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Upgrade call > Originating user upgrading the call
Content: When in the "T2: in-progress basic group call" state, upon receiving an indication from the user to upgrade the call to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" or "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" or when in the "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state, upon receiving an indication from the user to upgrade the call to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL", the MCPTT client: if the user request is to upgrade the call to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and the value of " / x / x /OffNetwork/EmergencyCallChange" leaf node present in the user profile as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 is set to "true": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall store the current UTC time as last call type change time of the call; shall store own MCPTT user ID as last user to change call type of the call; shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; shall stop timer TFG11 (emergency end retransmission), if running; shall stop timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril), if running; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; if the user request is to upgrade the call to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" and the value of " / x / x /OffNetwork/ ImminentPerilCallChange" leaf node present in the user profile as specified in 3GPP TS 24.483 set to "true": [ a) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall store the current UTC time as last call type change time of the call; shall store own MCPTT user ID as last user to change call type of the call; shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; shall stop timer TFG12 (imminent peril end retransmission), if running; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; shall generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 15.1.3. In the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, the MCPTT client: [ a) ] shall set the Call identifier IE to the stored call identifier of the call associated with the basic call control state machine; shall set the Call type IE to the stored current call type; shall set the Refresh interval IE to the stored refresh interval of the call associated with the basic call control state machine; shall set the SDP IE to the stored SDP body of the call associated with the basic call control state machine; shall set the Originating MCPTT user ID IE to the stored originating MCPTT user ID of the call associated with the basic call control state machine; shall set the MCPTT group ID IE to the stored MCPTT group ID of the call associated with the basic call control state machine; shall set the call start time IE to the stored call start time of the call; shall set the Last call type change time IE to the stored last call type change time of the call; and shall set the Last user to change call type IE to the stored last user to change call type of the call; and shall send the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message as specified in clause 10.2.1.1.1;
Title Path: Group call > Off-network group call > Call type control > Procedures > Upgrade call > Terminating UE receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message when participating in the ongoing call
Content: When in the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state or "T2: in-progress basic group call" state or "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state, upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCPTT group ID IE matching with MCPTT group ID of the ongoing call and the Call Identifier IE being the same as the stored call identifier of the call, the MCPTT client: if the stored last user to change call type of the call is same as the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and the stored last call type change time is smaller than Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message: [ a) ] shall set the stored last call type change time of the call to Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is other than "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is other than "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL"; shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; and if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is other than "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network basic group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall stop timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency), if running; shall stop timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril), if running; and shall enter "T2: in-progress basic group call" state; and if the stored last user to change call type of the call is different from the Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and: a) if the stored call type is same as Call type IE in the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and the stored last call type change time is smaller than Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message: [ i) ] shall set the stored last call type change time of the call to Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; and shall set the stored last user to change call type of the call to Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; [ a) ] if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is other than "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored last call type change time of the call to Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored last user to change call type of the call to Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network emergency group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall stop timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril), if running; shall start timer TFG13 (implicit downgrade emergency) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.1; and shall enter "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state; and if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored last call type change time of the call to Last call type change time IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored last user to change call type of the call to Last user to change call type IE of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message; shall set the stored current call type to "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL "; shall set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to value corresponding to MCPTT off-network imminent peril group call as described in 3GPP TS 24.483 ; shall start timer TFG14 (implicit downgrade imminent peril) with value as specified in clause 10.2.3.4.1.2; and shall enter "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state; and if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "BASIC GROUP CALL" and the stored call type is other than "BASIC GROUP CALL": [ i) ] shall set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL";
